_comment: GOLDEN-63, 1 h, lane_carry OFF arm — the golden305 armed set transplanted onto the
63-station FT63 network with the COLOCATED CONSUMER HOLDOUT: 61 stations in-network,
WTZZ00DEU withheld and driven as the closed-loop consumer while its colocated partners
WTZR00DEU and WTZS00DEU stay in the producer.  Structurally parallel to _golden305_gps:
_golden305_gps = _agu305_gps (303 sta + closed_loop WTZZ) + golden instrumentation
_golden63_gps  = _agu63      ( 61 sta + closed_loop WTZZ) + golden instrumentation
Both extend the SAME chain node (_ft63_pdfix_v3), so the science posture is identical
except for network size and the lane knob below.
PURPOSE: same as the 30 min 305 arm — confirm every armed instrument is wired and live,
and read its run-end counters (prires families, mdb rows binned, block_baarda n_blocks +
size histogram, datum_graph components, congruence stations swept).  An ABSENT counter
block means that card is not in the build (unknown JSON keys are silently ignored,
invariant #4).  1 h at 30 s = ~120 epochs, so redundancy_census_stride 10 yields ~12
sweep epochs — double the 6 the 30 min 305 arm produced.
THE LANE KNOB — this file is the OFF half of a matched pair.  _agu63 inherits
lane_carry.enable TRUE from _ft63_24h_conv; _agu305_gps overrides it FALSE.  The 305
override was a SPEED call (12x: applyLaneMeasurement was 84.7 % of a 305-sta epoch for a
0 % AR fix rate) and CLAUDE.md states it does NOT transfer below ~100 stations — at ~60
sta lane-off measured a small net LOSS (2084 -> 2207 ms/epoch: dd-build -73 % but
install-post nearly tripled).  So at this scale the knob is decided on SCIENCE, and the
standing verdict is 'MW/WL as conditioning — do NOT arm; net-harmful'.  This arm takes
that verdict; _golden63_gps_1h_laneon.json is its control.
WHAT THE PAIR ACTUALLY MEASURES: lane on/off changes carry RETENTION and that is
UNGRADED.  Whole-block marginalizations measured lane ON = 0 over 1440 epochs vs lane
OFF = 735 over 31.  Without pair-joining a per-band component whose chords all refloat
is discarded wholesale, where the joint block survived if either band did.  Read the
delta in the block_baarda block-size histogram, the prires cb/pb row counts and the
carry_vce per-family factors between the two arms.
PARALLELISM: inherited and already complete — eigen_threads 20, parallel_stations true,
parallel_min_stations 8, parallel_max_threads absent (= all 20 logical cores),
parallel_seam true, parallel_carry true.  network.parallel_reduce stays OFF: it is MUTEX
with parallel_carry (GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:974 forces parallel_carry OFF when both
are set, with only a warning), and its ceiling is ~1.02x because reduce is ~2 % of the
epoch, against parallel_carry's measured 2.13x.  Arming it makes the run SLOWER.
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY: arms fingerprinted knobs, so it must converge fresh.  Its output
paths are its own — never resume it onto another arm's snapshot.
SCOPE: 1 h grades wiring + cost + the lane retention delta.  It still cannot settle
total_IF on this lineage (the LEVEL channel needs ~2 h).
